rv.q: Michael Harrison's production is an effective celebration of the showy elements of panto that mark most people's introduction to theatre.
I wholeheartedly confess that Robin Hood has made a merry man out of me.

cn.t: Julian Clary leads another crowd-pleasing Palladium panto that scores a bullseye with outrageous innuendo, over-the-top spectacle, and glamorous festive fun that delights audiences.
